description: Hardened Gravitee API Management (APIM) community edition on 0-CVE nonroot images. The gateway, the management API and the console, with a bundled MongoDB. Enterprise plugins are not included.

Hardened runtime security in one install: Falco (syscall rules with the modern eBPF probe, JSON alerts naming the container) + Tetragon (kernel-level process, file and network events with TracingPolicy hooks and enforcement). Every image is QuenchWorks-hardened, built from source, 0-CVE, pinned by…
Kamaji is the Hosted Control Plane Manager for Kubernetes.
